changelog: The forecast, deal-value, ROI, mentor-impact and source-outcome readers count hires through the one placement rule (`src/lib/placement.ts`, #3472): coaching pairs and hires that are not ours no longer read as placements there either. Data with no kind or attribution set reads exactly as before.

en: Forecasts, ROI, mentor impact and partner outcomes now count only placements made through your programme.
tr: Tahminler, ROI, mentor etkisi ve partner sonuçları artık yalnızca programınız aracılığıyla yapılan yerleştirmeleri sayıyor.
de: Prognose, ROI, Mentoren-Wirkung und Partnerergebnisse zählen jetzt nur Vermittlungen über Ihr Programm.
